experiments.title: One bullet left: direct exchange opening
experiments.hypothesis: Opening chronology/compression; runtime also shortens. No label-only second test.
experiments.limitation: Shorter duration and different publication time/audience prevent causal attribution.

reviews.decision: Inconclusive: one-post cohort; largest retention drop at 2 seconds. Direct-opening test prepared.
Inconclusive: possible operator contribution; excluded from campaign growth.

coverage: 87 public records plus seven private/unlisted YouTube records counted only in aggregate: 94 measured posts. Historical coverage is not campaign growth. Source timestamps differ. YouTube Live archives, X, Twitch, FACEIT and unavailable archives remain unmeasured.

learningAudits.decision: Views and retention select different candidates. Test direct continuous action; do not declare a winning format from period totals.

learningAudits.test: Approved direct-exchange variant after control 24h checkpoint; no duplicate render

learningAudits.window: Initial synthesis of dated post observations and the September 13 through October 10 YouTube report; no matched weekly series collected.
learningAudits.decision: Inconclusive. Keep the existing direct-exchange opening test; no winning format or week-over-week trend established.
learningAudits.bottleneck: The control loses the most viewers around two seconds. Immediate action is a hypothesis to test, not a proven remedy.
learningAudits.test: Use the already approved 7.85-second direct-exchange variant after the control 24-hour checkpoint. Keep the control wording, layout and replay disclosure.
learningAudits.evaluation: Compare supported same-age native retention, average watch, views and followers at actual publication +4/24/72/168 hours. Runtime and sequential audiences limit interpretation.
limits: No two completed comparable seven-day windows were collected.
Period views, lifetime totals and publication-age metrics have different scopes.
A shorter runtime can raise completion percentage without improving absolute watch time.
No verified receipts or paid/organic attribution; no creative winner established.

Realtime figures are rolling and updating live; compare with their own timestamps rather than campaign cumulative totals.
No winning format, attribution, revenue, source-rights or exact simultaneous-publication conclusion follows from this graph.
